connector.name: Kwork
connector.registryDescription: Kwork freelance marketplace: browse projects, submit offers, manage orders, message clients
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kwork-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the simonether account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KWORK_LOGIN
env.description: Kwork login (required unless KWORK_TOKEN is set)

env.name: KWORK_PASSWORD
env.description: Kwork password (required unless KWORK_TOKEN is set)

env.name: KWORK_TOKEN
env.description: Auth token, skips login (alternative to KWORK_LOGIN + KWORK_PASSWORD)

env.name: KWORK_BURST_LIMIT
env.description: Burst limit for the rate limiter
